usedFor: Help Scout holds customers and conversations, and Zoom registers them for webinars through “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Customer” in Help Scout, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A customer record change can sign that person up for a webinar, without anyone retyping their details.

watchOut: “Update Customer” fires on every customer update, so the same person can reach “Register Attendee for Webinar” twice.
